site.name: Jezero crater floor / Octavia E. Butler landing site

local_axes: x east, y north, metres from site origin; heights in metres above the source vertical datum

encoding.note: 0.02 m steps are serialization, not measurement precision

method: Source window read by exact byte range; bilinear resampling to a local azimuthal-equidistant grid at 1 m posts; coarser levels are centred box means of that grid; imagery is block-averaged. Tiles carry a one-post apron so normals are continuous across tile edges.
limitations: Finest geometry equals the source DTM posting; features smaller than about 3-4 posts are not resolved.
Stereo DTMs contain interpolation artifacts in low-texture or shadowed areas; no per-pixel error map is published.
Imagery is single-band relative brightness under one illumination; it is not color and not calibrated albedo.
No subsurface, mechanical soil property or mineralogy is contained in these products.

dtm.product: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM mosaic, 1 m/px
dtm.citation: Fergason et al. 2020, USGS Astrogeology Science Center, doi:10.5066/P9REJ9JN
dtm.vertical_datum: Elevation above the Mars areoid (MOLA topography, DeltaGeoid product)
dtm.kind: stereo-derived reconstruction (HiRISE photogrammetry tied to CTX/HRSC/MOLA)

ortho.product: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE orthorectified image mosaic, 25 cm/px
ortho.citation: Fergason et al. 2020, USGS Astrogeology Science Center, doi:10.5066/P9QJDP48
ortho.kind: orbital panchromatic (HiRISE RED) orthoimage; 8-bit relative brightness, not calibrated albedo or color
